title: Master Services Agreement (Acme Corp & Beta LLC)

pages.content:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Agreement is entered into on January 15, 2026, by and between Acme Corp ('Client') and Beta LLC ('Provider').
Section 1. Scope of Work. Provider shall provide software engineering and systems integration consulting as detailed in Statements of Work ('SOW').
Section 2. Fees and Invoicing. Client shall pay Provider at the rate of $225 per hour. Invoices shall be submitted bi-weekly and payable Net 30 days. Late payments shall incur a service fee of 1.5% per month.

Section 3. Term and Termination. This Agreement commences on February 1, 2026, and continues for twelve (12) months. Either party may terminate for convenience upon thirty (30) days prior written notice. In the event of material breach, the non-breaching party may terminate with ten (10) days written notice if uncured.
Section 4. Limitation of Liability. EXCEPT FOR BREACHES OF CONFIDENTIALITY OR INDEMNIFICATION, NEITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY SHALL EXCEED THE TOTAL FEES PAID UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE PRECEDING SIX (6) MONTHS. IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE FOR PUNITIVE OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES.

Section 5. Confidentiality. Each party agrees to protect proprietary information with the same degree of care it uses for its own confidential materials, but not less than reasonable care, for a period of three (3) years post-termination.
Section 6. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflicts of law principles. Any dispute shall be resolved via binding arbitration in Wilmington, Delaware.

COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
Landlord: Metro Properties REIT
Tenant: Nexa Dynamics Inc.
Premises: Suite 402, 500 Market Street, San Francisco, CA 94105.
Term: Commencing March 1, 2026, expiring February 28, 2029 (36 calendar months).
Base Rent: Tenant shall pay monthly base rent in the amount of $8,500 due on the first day of each calendar month. A late charge of 5% applies after the 5th day of the month.
Security Deposit: Tenant shall deposit $17,000 upon execution of this Lease.

Permitted Use: General office and software development only. No hazardous materials or loud machinery.
Maintenance and Repairs: Tenant shall maintain interior fixtures, HVAC filters, and internal plumbing. Landlord shall be responsible for roof, structural foundations, and common building areas.
Subleasing: Tenant may not assign or sublet the premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
